text_block_list.text:
Since Royce and Royce wasn't feeling well,
I brought her to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Phew. Irregularities are par for the course in any plan...
We need to urgently devise a countermeasure.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, rest comes first!
I need to balance work and rest, and get in peak condition
with maximum cost-efficiency!"

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
—Now then...
Let's give another round of applause to Royce-san
for winning the Mega Hyper Producer Award!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Thank you...!
Being able to stand on this stage today... makes me truly happy.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Above all, as everyone knows,
Mega Best means the best in glasses.
To receive an award bearing such a name—

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Intruder
text_block_list.text: —Hold it! That prize belongs to me... the "Mega Master"!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Mega Master...!?
In other words... the master of glasses!?

text_block_list.name: Buzzing Crowd
text_block_list.text:
"Mega Master... I've heard of them!"
"Using boundless wealth to craft ultra-rare glasses from every material imaginable, just to brag endlessly..."

text_block_list.name: Mega Master
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... Obsidian glasses, meteorite glasses, crystal glasses! This collection is the undeniable proof that I deserve the prize!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. It seems... you have misunderstood the true value of glasses.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I have met many meganistas until now.
Every single one of them exuded a brilliant charm, you know.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Glasses are the item that makes a character sparkle even more.
Yes—it's only when glasses and person become one
that they shine with true brilliance!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Forgetting that means you are unworthy of wearing glasses!
Take this: Mega Nova Flash!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Mega Master
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaahhhh!?!?

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Glasses Break KO! Magnificent...!
Indeed, the one worthy of the Mega Hyper Produce Award was Royce-san~!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
With that radiance just now...
Your heart, which viewed glasses as mere collector's items, has been cleansed.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay. You can start over... Let's go search
for them together. The true glasses of your heart."

text_block_list.name: Mega Master (Good)
text_block_list.text: Glasses... of the heart...?

text_block_list.name: Buzzing Crowd
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh~!" "I don't really get it, but...
She's saying something super inspiring!"
"That's our Royce-chan, she's huge!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Gasp!? T-That was the most bizarre dream...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Still... I must say, I'm truly impressive.
I instantly turned an unexpected mishap into a self-branding opportunity!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: “Even against a sudden intruder, Royce-chan shows off her overwhelming main character power.” ...Fufu. Maybe it'll come true—
"...While the dream didn't literally come true, Royce and Royce was successfully restored to peak condition."
